tran541: Used to log in to the Transfer Wallet system and receive a Token/URL for opening the AskMeLotto page. If the player does not yet exist under the Agent, the system will automatically register the member using the submitted data.
tran54_req_agentUsername: Required — the Partner's Agent account username
tran54_req_agentApiKey: Required — the API Key issued to the Agent
tran54_req_playerUsername: Required — player username, 4–36 characters. If this playerUsername is not found in the system, the system will automatically register the member
tran54_req_data: Required — the player data object; data.currency must always be included
tran54_req_data_username: Optional — if sent, must contain only a–z and 0–9; playerUsername is used as the primary username
tran54_req_data_currency: Required — must always be sent, using a currency code such as THB or USD
tran54_req_data_rate: Optional — if not sent, the system will automatically use the Rate configured for the Agent
tran54_req_rate_lottotype: Rate group by lotto type, e.g. thailotto
tran54_req_rate_betType: Rate group by bet type, e.g. top3
tran54_req_max: Maximum bet amount per entry as configured
tran54_req_min: Minimum bet amount per entry as configured
tran54_req_payout: Payout rate for the bet type
tran54_res_code: Result code of the transaction; 0 indicates success
tran54_res_msg: Result message, separated by Thai (th) and English (en)
tran54_res_data: Data returned by the system when successful
tran54_res_playerApiId: Member ID in the AskMeLotto system
tran54_res_playerApiUsername: Full username in the AskMeLotto system, in the format playerUsername@agentUsername
tran54_res_playerUsername: Player username from the Partner system
tran54_res_tkUuid: Token used to open the web page, and used as a Bearer Token for Get Balance
tran54_res_url: URL for opening the AskMeLotto page
tran54_res_error_service: Present only for certain Service Error cases, to indicate the step where the problem occurred

tran581: Used to fetch a member's betting history under an Agent, including Ticket details, draw results, bet items, and pagination data.
tran582: If playerUsername is not sent, the system returns data for all members under the Agent.
tran58_req_agentUsername: Required — the Partner's Agent account username
tran58_req_agentApiKey: Required — the API Key issued to the Agent
tran58_req_playerUserName: Optional — full username in the format playerUserName@agentUsername; omitted or empty = all members under the Agent
tran58_req_currency: Required — the currency code; the system converts it to lowercase before validating
tran58_req_startDate: Optional — start date and time, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss; if neither startDate nor endDate is sent, the system uses the current date (UTC+7). The search range must not exceed 24 hours, and may not go back more than 3 months
tran58_req_endDate: Optional — end date and time, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss (UTC+7); if sent, endDate must not be earlier than startDate
tran58_req_isUpdate: Required — false = filter by bet date (created_at); true = filter by draw, cancellation, or last update date (update_at), based on the UTC+7 timezone
tran58_req_page: Optional — the page to retrieve; defaults to 1
tran58_req_limit: Optional — number of items per page; defaults to 50, maximum 100
tran58_res_code: Result code of the transaction; 0 indicates success
tran58_res_data_startDate: The start date used for the search
tran58_res_data_endDate: The end date used for the search
tran58_res_docs_datetime: The date and time the Ticket was created, UTC+7
tran58_res_docs_updatedAt: The date and time the Ticket was last updated, UTC+7
tran58_res_docs_goverment: true = government lotto set; false = not a government lotto set (field name goverment kept as-is from the legacy system)
tran58_res_docs_status: The Ticket's status; supported values are pending, cancel, and success
tran58_res_docs_drawResult: The draw result; may be null if the Ticket has not been finalized
tran58_res_txtList_betKey: Reference ID for the bet item
tran58_res_txtList_betStatus: The bet result status: pending = awaiting result; true = won; false = did not win; cancel = result cancelled
tran58_res_txtList_rateLevel: Payout reduction level; 0 = normal rate, up to 4 reduction levels
tran58_res_txtList_rateLevelAmount: Amount reduced from the payout rate
tran58_res_txtList_betResultKey: The result key matching the bet

tran591: Used to fetch the details of a specified Ticket's betting history, including draw results, bet items, and pagination data. All dates and times are based on the UTC+7 timezone.
tran59_req_agentUsername: Required — the Agent account used to call the API
tran59_req_ticketId: Optional — if a value greater than 0 is sent, the system searches by Ticket ID and ignores startDate/endDate; if omitted or 0, the system searches by date range
tran59_req_startDate: Optional — start date and time, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss (UTC+7); used when ticketId is not specified or is 0. If neither startDate nor endDate is sent, the system uses the current date. The search range must not exceed 24 hours, and may not go back more than 3 months
tran59_req_endDate: Optional — end date and time, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss (UTC+7); used when ticketId is not specified or is 0, and must not be earlier than startDate
tran59_req_page: Optional — the page number; defaults to 1
tran59_req_limit: Optional — number of items per page; defaults to 50, maximum 100
tran59_req_currency: Required — the currency code, e.g. THB
tran59_req_isUpdate: Required — false = filter by bet date (created_at); true = filter by draw, cancellation, or last update date (update_at), based on the UTC+7 timezone
tran59_err_72003: ticketId does not belong to this member or Agent

tranOut1: Used to check a single member's outstanding (pending-result) bets. The system aggregates amounts by game type and returns the member's currency.
tranOut_req_agentUsername: Required — the Agent account used to call the API
tranOut_req_playerUsername: Required — the username's front part only, without @agentUsername; the system appends the Agent name automatically
tranOut_res_code: Result code of the transaction; 0 indicates success
tranOut_res_data_totalOutstanding: The member's total outstanding bet amount
tranOut_res_data_currency: The member's currency, read from the member's data; not sent with the Request
tranOut_res_data_list: The outstanding amounts, grouped by product type
tranOut_res_data_list_lotto: The outstanding amounts for the lotto product; an empty [] if there is no data
tranOut_res_lotto_gameId: The lotto game type ID; amounts for the same game type across draws are combined
tranOut_res_lotto_outstanding: The outstanding bet amount for that game type
tranOut_note: Note: if there are no outstanding tickets, the system returns totalOutstanding as 0 and list.lotto as [], not null.
